name: Curse of the Mantle
source:
On April 2nd 1944, NBC Radio aired "The Curse of the Mantle" as an episode on Weird Circle, a radio drama series consisting of horror and weird fiction.

When the governor's niece Lady Eleanore receives a cursed mantle, she begins to change and her life falls apart pulling the entire town with her. Her fiance George Helwyse who tried before to warn her about the mantle, dedicates his life to get rid of it. This is a visual novel based on the radio drama adaptation of Nathaniel Hawthorne's short story Lady Eleanore's Mantle.

[Edited from [url=https://asatiir.itch.io/curse-of-the-mantle]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1944年4月2日，NBC广播电台在由恐怖和怪异小说组成的广播连续剧《怪圈》中播出了《斗篷的诅咒》一集。

当总督的侄女埃莉诺夫人收到了被诅咒的斗篷时，她开始发生变化，她的生活崩溃了，整个城镇也随之崩溃。她的未婚夫乔治·赫尔维斯（George Helwyse）曾试图警告她有关斗篷的事情，但现在却毕生致力于摆脱它。这是一部根据纳撒尼尔·霍桑的短篇小说《埃莉诺夫人的斗篷》广播剧改编的视觉小说。

[编辑自[url=https://asatiir.itch.io/curse-of-the-mantle]itch.io[/url]]
